name: worlds-2026-live
description: Live LoL Worlds 2026 tracker: Next.js, Supabase sync, official LoL Esports data

paragraphs: A live League of Legends Worlds 2026 tracker: schedule, results, Play-In bracket, Swiss and knockout views, team profiles, recaps and statistics. Built with Next.js (App Router), strict TypeScript, Tailwind CSS, Zod, TanStack Query and optional Supabase.
Fan project. Not affiliated with or endorsed by Riot Games.
features: Match, schedule, score and VOD data come from the LoL Esports service behind lolesports.com. Nothing is invented. A match that the source calls "live" far from its scheduled start is shown as unverified.
Champion picks per game come from Riot's live stats feed (ingested by the sync job for new games, with a seed in src/data/games-seed.json; winners per game are not in the feed).
Per-game winners and MVP are not in the official feed, so they are not shown.
Without Supabase the app still works in cache-only mode (live upstream data, short in-memory cache, no admin edits, no sync history).
Liquipedia (unofficial) fills rosters, substitutes, coaches/analysts and social links when LIQUIPEDIACONTACT is set. See "Secondary source" below.
